**Key findings:** Nara's 2026 IT calendar is thin but has two real academic conferences — **WSSE 2026** (Oct 16–18, software engineering, ACM) and **NLPIR 2026** (Dec 11–13, NLP/IR, Springer), both at Nara Women's University with submission deadlines in late June 2026. A third conference (ICDCN, distributed computing) already ran in January. Monthly **CoderDojo** meetups round out the local community scene. For industry/developer events, Osaka (40 min) and Kyoto (35 min) are the practical alternatives.
